title: Who’s News: Strategic Appointments at PQShield, VTT, QuantWare, and Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute - Quantum Computing Report
gist: Four quantum organizations made leadership hires: PQShield added a CCO and a Sovereign Advisor, VTT a quantum VP, QuantWare a CFO, and RPI a quantum constellation chair.

insights.claim: PQShield appointed Hal Conklin, with over 30 years of commercial technology experience, as CCO to lead global sales and U.S. expansion.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Signals a push into U.S. commercial sales for post-quantum cryptography.

insights.claim: PQShield added Gemma Ungoed-Thomas, former UK Cabinet Office Director for State Threats, Cyber and Technology, as Sovereign Advisor for public-sector strategy as global PQC adoption accelerates.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Government-facing hire suggests public-sector PQC procurement is a focus.

insights.claim: QuantWare named Bart Filius, former CFO of Galapagos and CFO of Sanofi Europe, as CFO and board member effective Oct 12, 2026 to lead capital allocation as it scales industrial fabrication at its KiloFab facility.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: A CFO with IPO experience hints at future capital-raising readiness.

insights.claim: VTT appointed Jani Kivioja, formerly of Nokia and Picosun, as VP of Quantum Technologies from Nov 1, 2026 to oversee quantum R&D and commercialization across computing, sensing and communications.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Reflects Finland's institutional emphasis on commercializing quantum research.

insights.claim: RPI appointed James Misewich of Brookhaven National Laboratory as Curtis R. Priem Quantum Computing Constellation Chair from Jan 1, 2027, to lead quantum strategy and expand collaboration with Brookhaven.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Strengthens the RPI-Brookhaven link in the U.S. quantum ecosystem.
